items.description: List of changed entries for the requested page.

page.description: Current page number. The number of the first page is 1.

size.description: Number of items requested per page.

totalElements.description: Total number of changed entries matching the query.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages for the matching result set.

ChangelogChangeItem.description: A single changelog entry describing a change to a platform entity.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with milliseconds when the change occurred, for example `2026-06-01T13:01:29.123Z`.

type.description:
Change type returned by the API.
* `create` — Document insert.
* `update` — Document update or replace.
* `delete` — Document delete.

entity.description: Logical entity type of the changed document, for example `order`, `customer`, `company`, `product`, `segment`, `group`, `group-assignment`, `coupon`, `quote`, `site`, or a custom entity created with the Schema Service.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the changed document.

name.description: Optional display name of the changed document when available.

paths.description: Flattened map of changed field paths to before/after values derived from the change patch.

schemaVersion.description: Optional schema or document format version associated with the change.

actor.description: Actor display name that performed the change. Possible values include a person name, `system`, `external`, or `unknown`.

related.description: Related entities linked to the changed document, for example junction-style references.

ChangelogRelatedItem.description: A related entity referenced by a changelog entry.

entity.description: Related entity type, for example `group` or `customer`.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the related entity.

PathValueChange.description: Before and after values for a changed field path.

before.description: Value of the field before the change. Omitted when not available.

after.description: Value of the field after the change. Omitted when not available.
